facts_of_case: Petitioner is the legally wedded wife of respondent. They got married at Vizianagaram on 15.08.2024 as per Hindu rites and customs. Petitioner filed petition under Section 24 of Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 seeking to withdraw F.C.O.P.No.2335 of 2024 from Family Judge-Cum-V Additional District Judge, Visakhapatnam and transfer the same to Family Court at Vizianagaram.

legal_principles.principle: A transfer petition filed by a wife may be allowed if she does not have sufficient funds to visit the place where the divorce petition is filed by her husband.
legal_principles.held: By considering the fact that 'if a wife does not have sufficient funds to visit the place where the divorce petition is filed by her husband, then the transfer petition filed by the wife may be allowed.'
cited_cases: GEETA HEERA Vs HARISH CHANDER , (Year) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: A wife may be allowed to transfer a case from one place to another if she does not have sufficient male support.
legal_principles.held: In view of the above, it is held that 'the cardinal principle for exercise of power under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, is that the burden lies on the wife to show that she has no male support.'
cited_cases: N.C.V. Aishwarya Vs A.S.Saravana Karthik Sha^h^l

outcome.final_order: Service held sufficient. Petitioner's petition under Section 24 of Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 seeking to withdraw F.C.O.P.No.2335 of 2024 from Family Judge-Cum-V Additional District Judge, Visakhapatnam and transfer the same to Family Court at Vizianagaram is allowed.
